output.title: Ingress pathType change affects cert-manager HTTP challenge handling
output.content: This change modifies the Kubernetes Ingress pathType from ImplementationSpecific to Exact for cert-manager's HTTP challenge handling. The environment has global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole set, indicating HTTP challenge support is configured. This change affects Ingress resources that cert-manager creates for HTTP challenges. Review your ingress controller compatibility with Exact pathType and ensure it properly handles cert-manager's HTTP challenge ingresses.
